messages:
maria: Pushing a small iteration on the org settings page. Focus areas: roles matrix density, invite modal affordances, SSO toggle discoverability, and a quick path to audit entries after invites. Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc
aj: Quick scan: primary CTA proximity still feels risky on mobile. Also the 'Add role' inline action looks like a link not a button. Can we make it a pill button?
natasha: Keyboard/navigation issue: tab order sends focus from the role selector to the submit button then to the SSO toggle. Should be SSO toggle before submit. Also the SSO toggle lacks an accessible label.
tom: On small widths the role chips wrap and push actions off-screen. Suggest truncating long role names and adding ellipsis + tooltip. Also consider a compact density mode toggle for teams with >50 seats.
maria: For audit flow: after sending invites show a persistent 'View invite events' link in the toast that routes to /org/audit?event=invite&user=email@example.com . That gives a clear recovery path.
aj: Microcopy suggestion: use 'Require SSO for this account' instead of 'Require SSO for this user' -- clearer for org-level enforcement.
design-bot: Contrast scan: disabled SSO label = 3.6:1 (fail AA). Recommend color swap or bold weight. Also automated keyboard test flagged tab-order mismatch.
natasha: I'll update the DOM order and add aria-label="Require SSO for invited users" and role="switch" plus aria-checked toggling.
maria: Action list: 1) make 'Add role' a pill button, 2) reorder DOM to match visual flow, 3) add toast CTA to filtered audit view, 4) compact density CSS under 720px, 5) microcopy update to 'Require SSO for this account', 6) bump disabled label contrast. I'll open a PR and tag design + qa.
aj: I'll pair on an e2e that asserts tab order and role=switch.
natasha: I'll run VoiceOver and NVDA checks once PR is up.
maria: Thanks all, aiming to merge after accessibility pass. :rocket:
